title: BFF authorisation and session gate rely on unverified JWT payload decoded with atob
test_evidence: Commit 84623e13. server.verified.test.ts with the parent apps/web/src/lib/auth/server.ts: 8 of 10 fail (forged, alg:none, HMAC, tampered, wrong-iss and wrong-aud tokens all produced a session; Keycloak tenant_id ignored; no fail-closed in a deployed stage); after: 10/10. jwks-verifier.test.ts 18/18 (RS256 + ES256 positive controls; forged, tampered, none/HS256/RS512, wrong iss/aud, expired, nbf, unknown kid with rate-limited refresh, JWKS outage fail closed)
notes: Topic 1 Option A approved 2026-10-27 (owner dbn1972). Scheduled in owner-tracks batch t1-web-console-jwks-batch8. Shipped: dependency-free WebCrypto JWKS verifier (RS256/ES256, iss, aud/azp, exp, nbf, kid cache with TTL) used by the Edge middleware and server getSession(); configured from KEYCLOAK_ISSUER / KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_ID / KEYCLOAK_AUDIENCE / KEYCLOAK_JWKS_URI (the gateway's names); APP_ENV/DEPLOY_ENV=staging|production without that config fails closed. Unmet step: the web Deployment (infrastructure/k8s/base/web, helm web) does not yet set KEYCLOAK_ISSUER / KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_ID or APP_ENV, so a deployed pod stays in decode-only mode until those values are added (infra/T8 change, not in this batch); in the gateway's local HS-JWT mode there is no JWKS and front-end pods hold no JWT_SECRET (PRC-M279), so decode-only remains there. The gateway still verifies every forwarded token.

title: Tenant resolution falls back to client-supplied x-tenant-id header, then literal 'default'
test_evidence: Commit 12dfc184. gateway.tenant-source.test.ts with the parent gateway.ts: 5 of 7 fail (Keycloak tenant_id ignored, verified token without tenant claim sent with the header tenant, multi-valued claim and forged token forwarded, anonymous call sent as 'default'); after: 7/7. gateway.test.ts 'falls back to default' case replaced by 'refuses (sends nothing)'; lib/api gateway suites 36/36
notes: Topic 4 Option A approved 2026-10-27 (owner dbn1972). Scheduled in owner-tracks batch t1-web-console-jwks-batch8. getSessionContext()/gatewayFetch take the tenant only from the verified token claim (tenantId or Keycloak tenant_id; one value); a token without one is not forwarded and no request is sent (401 TENANT_UNRESOLVED). Anonymous calls use only the middleware's Host-derived x-tenant-id (client copies are stripped, PRC-M153); the literal 'default' fallback is removed. init.tenantId can no longer override the token tenant on an authenticated call.

test_evidence: Commit 4c3656d8 (includes the Next build alias that resolves @proctira/auth .js imports; next build of apps/admin-console compiles the Edge middleware). middleware.verify.test.ts with the parent middleware.ts, lib/auth/server.ts and lib/auth/session.ts: 12 of 14 fail (forged, alg:none, HMAC, wrong-iss, wrong-aud and tenant tokens opened console pages; tenant token with super-admin got a session; role-less platform token passed requireSession; Keycloak tenant_id ignored; no fail-closed in a deployed stage); after: 14/14; admin-console suite 115/115 at that commit
notes: Topic 1 Option A approved 2026-10-27 (owner dbn1972). Scheduled in owner-tracks batch t1-web-console-jwks-batch8. Middleware and getSession() verify the token with the shared JWKS verifier and require tenantId (or tenant_id) = platform; requireSession() sends a verified platform token with no platform role to /forbidden, so the dashboard has a role check. apps/admin-console gains @proctira/auth workspace:* (lockfile importer only; lockfile diff check: no new external package). Unmet step: the admin-console Deployment does not yet set KEYCLOAK_ISSUER / KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_ID or APP_ENV (infra/T8), so deployed pods stay decode-only until then.

title: Session lifecycle: refresh token never used, logout does not revoke upstream, no MFA/lockout on platform login
test_evidence: Commit 9c780d54. session-lifecycle.test.ts with the parent logout route and middleware and no refresh route: 6 of 7 fail (no /api/auth/refresh; logout made no upstream call; an authentic expired token was sent to /login instead of refreshed); after: 7/7; admin-console suite 122/122
notes: Topic 1 Option A approved 2026-10-27 (owner dbn1972). Scheduled in owner-tracks batch t1-web-console-jwks-batch8. Shipped: POST /api/auth/refresh rotates both cookies through the auth service /auth/refresh (platform tenant; failure clears every admin cookie); the middleware refreshes an authentic expired token single-flight per refresh token and replays the navigation; logout calls the gateway's authenticated POST /api/v1/auth/logout with the bearer and refresh token before clearing cookies. Lockout on platform login is enforced upstream by the gateway /auth/login lockout service (packages/backend/auth/src/routes.ts lockoutService; cited, not changed). Unmet step: no MFA step on platform login (the console has no UI for the gateway pre-MFA ticket and OTP flow, PRC-M497).

notes: Topic 1 Option A approved 2026-10-27 (owner dbn1972). Scheduled in owner-tracks batch t1-web-console-jwks-batch8. replayAll is single-flight per tab and across tabs (Web Locks ifAvailable); 401/403 pause the drain with outcome paused_auth and no attempt spent; other permanent 4xx park the op (attemptCount = MAX_ATTEMPTS) for the conflict dialog; same-origin replays send x-csrf-token from the csrf_token cookie and credentials: same-origin, never to another origin.

Test-gap finding, so the proof is a mutation run: forwarding the client x-tenant-id in login, dropping sanitizeReturnTo in callback and passing a tokenless 200 through in mfa/verify make 3 tests fail; restored: 14/14; app/api/auth 46/46
notes: Topic 1 Option A approved 2026-10-27 (owner dbn1972). Scheduled in owner-tracks batch t1-web-console-jwks-batch8. notes: Topic 1 Option A approved 2026-10-27 (owner dbn1972). Scheduled in owner-tracks batch t1-web-console-jwks-batch8. NodeSamlResponseParser over @node-saml/node-saml 5.2.0 (pinned in t6-dependency-lockfile-batch0): XML-DSig on the assertion against the configured IdP certificate, Conditions with 60 s skew, AudienceRestriction = SP entity id, InResponseTo = the pending AuthnRequest id; it is the createSAMLProvider default.
